title: Simultaneous Speech-to-Speech Translation Without Aligned Data

target_claims.claim: Hibiki-Zero trains simultaneous speech translation from sentence-level aligned speech data rather than word-level aligned interpretation data (Section 3).

evidence_details.training_signal: whole-sentence pairs only; no word-level timing labels
evidence_details.observation: a streaming emitter trained purely from sentence-aligned pairs reaches high held-out accuracy once one token of lookahead is allowed

target_claims.claim: Hibiki-Zero casts latency-quality optimization as reinforcement learning with GRPO over multistream speech/text outputs (Section 3.3).

evidence_details.algorithm: group-relative advantages over sampled rollouts, policy-gradient update on a wait/emit policy
evidence_details.observation: the latency weight beta measurably moves the trained operating point along the latency-quality trade-off

target_claims.claim: The final Hibiki-Zero architecture is a 3B-parameter decoder-only multistream model built on RQ-Transformer audio token modeling (Section 4.1).
target_claims.scope: residual-quantization and multistream factorization mechanisms only; the 3B-parameter model is not instantiated

target_claims.claim: On Europarl-ST and Audio-NTREX-4L, Hibiki-Zero reports better long-form ASR BLEU, speaker similarity, and latency than Seamless, and improves over Hibiki on French short-form ASR BLEU (Table 1).
target_claims.reason: requires the released 3B checkpoint and the Europarl-ST/Audio-NTREX-4L evaluation harnesses, none of which are runnable in this CPU-only package; no benchmark numbers are reported rather than fabricating them

target_claims.claim: Human MOS evaluations rate Hibiki-Zero higher than Seamless on audio quality, speaker similarity, and speech naturalness across evaluated input languages (Table 2).
target_claims.reason: a human mean-opinion-score study requires human raters; it cannot be reproduced computationally and must not be synthesized

target_claims.claim: The model adapts to Italian-to-English simultaneous translation using 850 hours of fine-tuning data and reports Seamless-level quality/latency with better speaker similarity after RL (Table 3).
target_claims.reason: requires 850 hours of Italian-English speech and large-scale fine-tuning infrastructure unavailable to this package

provenance: all numbers computed by generate_evidence.py with pinned seeds; fabricated benchmark/MOS tables removed 2026-08-01
